Thanks Rachel — this is a helpful starter. A few procurement-specific clarifications so we can circulate an MAP to our stakeholders: 

1) We need to confirm which contract will hold data processing obligations (MSA vs DPA vs Order Form). Our legal team prefers DPA language embedded in the MSA rather than a stand-alone DPA.
2) Can Redwood provide SOC 2 reporting dates and a copy of the last runbook for incident response?
3) Order form: we need a draft that lists the expected committed capacity and RPO for data backups.

We'll aim to get back with our internal approvals timeline by EOD Wednesday.

— Priya
Procurement Lead, Avery Labs

Priya — thank you, great questions. I outlined a proposed sequencing below and attached a short MAP (Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf) that maps owners and expected sign-off milestones. High level: 

- Week 0 (this week): Alignment call + MAP shared (owner: me)
- Week 1: Security packet (SOC 2 + runbook) to procurement (owner: Jonas)
- Week 1–2: Legal review — MSA markups + DPA placement decision (owners: Kimberly + Avery Legal)
- Week 2: Order form draft with capacity numbers and billing term suggestion (owner: Rachel)
- Week 3: Final redlines, signatures via DocuSign (owner: Avery legal + Redwood legal)

For your specific points: 
- We can embed DPA clauses into the MSA. Kimberly can provide two options (embedded vs appendixed) and recommend which minimizes negotiation cycles.
- Attached: SOC 2 cover sheet and a lightly redacted incident response runbook excerpt (Jonas will send the SOC 2 pdf in the next email).
- I drafted an order form template with placeholders for committed capacity; if you can share expected baseline usage (tokens/day or concurrent sessions), we’ll populate it and propose committed tiers.

Next steps: 
1) Jonas to send security artifacts (today).
2) Kimberly to attach MSA/DPA placement options (tomorrow AM).
3) Priya to share internal procurement timing + any vendor checklist items we haven't covered.

Attaching: Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf (owner map + milestone dates)

Thanks — I’ll host a 30-min sync if it helps to walk the MAP live.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(rachel.kim@redwood.com)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Onramp: procurement sequencing & owner matrix for order form

Priya — looping in Redwood legal. Two practical options to reduce negotiation time: 

Option A (recommended): Embed DPA clauses into the MSA and lock the data processing appendix language via the order form. This keeps a single executable contract and avoids separate signature flows.

Option B: Keep a stand-alone DPA and have the MSA reference it; this is reasonable if Avery requires different legal signatories or additional attestations.

For the order form draft (attached: OrderForm_draft_avery.docx): 
- I put placeholder fields for: committed GPU-hours, burst capacity, SLA target, backup retention (RPO), and billing cadence.
- If Avery confirms committed GPU-hours and preferred SLA window, we can finalize pricing bands and minimize further redlines.

Proposed timeline (assuming internal approvals on your side by 2028-04-05): 
- 04/06: Legal exchange of MSA redlines and DPA placement decision
- 04/09: Order form finalized with capacity numbers
- 04/11: Signature via DocuSign; provisioning kickoff same day

If Avery needs us to accelerate, we can compress to a one-week close, but that requires a pre-approved order form and marking the DPA as embedded.

— Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — alignment looks good. A few commitments from our side: 
- Procurement will confirm vendor checklist and whether Avery legal wants the DPA embedded by 04/05 COB.
- Expect to share baseline usage (tokens/day equivalent) by tomorrow morning so you can populate the order form.
- We have one custom compliance ask around keys (Avery uses their KMS) — can Redwood support customer-managed keys for production? If yes, include an optional KMS integration line item in the order form.

We’ll plan for the 04/11 signature target but will flag if internal approvals slip. Please send the DocuSign envelope link once the final order form is ready.

Best,
Priya Menon
